description: Run a CFD, heat-transfer or conjugate thermal (CHT) simulation to predict temperatures, pressure drop, flow and forces on a meshed design. Uses GPU compute: usually 1–15 credits and 5–60 minutes for up to 20M cells; call estimate_cost first and check the budget. Not for quick what-ifs (use predict_physics or a design preview) or for checking inputs (use validate_simulation). Submit a new durable RANS/URANS/CHT simulation for an owned validated mesh. Use a fresh key for a newly requested run, even with identical inputs; keep the original key only for retries/resuming that run. Reuse completed results only when requested or accepted. Read get_request_schema(simulation), inspect actual mesh patches/zones, clarify the objective, flow/thermal conditions and consequential controls. Honor explicit choices; use disclosed best judgment for delegated choices and record assumptions in decision_context. Returns immediately with a job ID. Numerical acceptance is distinct from completion and publication. After any terminal outcome inspect get_job, get_job_events and owned summaries; report available residuals/forces/y+ with qualification, and resolved_physics. Provide the default browser viewer link automatically for valid published fields, with unqualified/nonconverged labels where applicable; do not auto-rerun. May incur GPU charges.

thermal.description: CHT only: heat transfer through this outer solid surface; default adiabatic.

BoundaryThermal.description: Heat transfer through an outer solid surface in a CHT run. Surfaces default to adiabatic.

ambient_temperature_k.description: Surrounding temperature in K; convection only.

emissivity.description: Surface emissivity for radiation to surroundings at ambient_temperature_k; 0 for none.

htc_w_m2k.description: Heat transfer coefficient to the surroundings in W/(m^2 K); convection only.

solid_zone.description: Solid zone that owns this surface; needed when the run has more than one solid zone.

type.description: adiabatic (no heat crosses) or convection to the surroundings, with optional radiation. Fixed-temperature and fixed-heat-flux surfaces are not available.

flow_direction.description: Nonzero Cartesian inlet direction for volumetric flow.

omega.description: Signed angular velocity in rad/s about axis (right-hand rule).

origin.description: Rotation origin in metres in the mesh coordinate system.

pressure.description: Absolute pressure in Pa. Legacy outlet/farfield zero means reference_pressure, not vacuum.

specific_dissipation_rate.description: Exact SST inlet omega in 1/s; supply with turbulent_kinetic_energy.

turbulence_intensity.description: Optional inlet turbulence fraction (0–1, not percent). Omit all inlet turbulence quantities to use model-specific solver defaults; provide both intensity and viscosity ratio for a custom inlet.

turbulent_kinetic_energy.description: Exact SST inlet k in m^2/s^2; supply with specific_dissipation_rate.

turbulent_viscosity_ratio.description: Optional inlet eddy/molecular viscosity ratio. Omit all inlet turbulence quantities for model-specific solver defaults; supply with turbulence_intensity for a custom inlet.

velocity.description: Cartesian velocity in m/s; mutually exclusive with inlet volumetric flow rate.

volumetric_flow_rate.description: Inlet volumetric flow in m^3/s, converted using actual inlet mesh area. Requires flow_direction.

zones.description: The two solid zones that touch.

ConvergenceCriteria.description: Fields as in assess_convergence: window_fraction, window_iterations, max_final_residual, residuals, residual_rise_orders, min_residual_orders_dropped, forces, force_band_percent, force_band_floor, max_energy_balance_error. Unset fields keep the standard test; unknown fields are rejected.

DecisionContext.description: User intent and declared assumptions, retained with the owned job request.

density.description: Density in kg/m^3; default is an air assumption, not a material lookup.

FluxCoreConfig.description: FluxCore controls; the native worker validates the mesh and solve.

airspeed.description: Freestream speed in m/s; zero is not a substitute for a missing operating point.

architecture.description: Fluxcore GPU solver. Use 'fluxcore'; 'workhorse' remains an accepted compatibility identifier for saved requests and deployed workers.

bdf_order.description: URANS backward-difference time order; resolved default 2.

compressible_config.description: Advanced FluxCore numerical controls. Search the solver-control catalogue for canonical names, architecture availability and defaults. Only explicit values are forwarded; unknown controls are rejected.

inner_cfl.description: Positive URANS pseudo-time CFL, or -1 for architecture default.

iterations_per_output.description: Output cadence in iterations/physical steps; 0 disables intermediate output, not final export.

max_iterations.description: Steady iteration ceiling; explicitly null for URANS. Unset, it follows run_quality.

mesh_scale_factor.description: Stored meshes are in meters. A different scale requires an explicit mesh_unit_conversion on the simulation request; OpenFOAM always requires 1.0.

mrf_zones.description: Multiple reference frames tied to actual mesh cell zones; rotating walls alone do not define a rotating fluid zone.

run_quality.description: Fills only unset limits: max_iterations 3000/6000/12000, convergence_tolerance 1e-4/1e-6/1e-7 and, for CHT, compressible_config.cht_outer_tol 1e-3/1e-4/1e-5.

scale_resolving.description: URANS only: ddes runs delayed detached-eddy simulation on the chosen turbulence model.

time_step.description: URANS physical time step in seconds; supply an engineering time scale.

turbulence_model.description: auto (default): k-omega SST for flow-only runs; for CHT laminar below Reynolds number 2300, otherwise k-omega SST. Set a model only when the user asks for one. The choice and its reason are returned as resolved_physics.

wall_function.description: Wall law used with wall functions, for the flow, the forces and the thermal wall handoff. Ignored when the walls are resolved (low_re or none).

wall_treatment.description: auto (default): wall functions valid at any y+ for turbulent flow, resolved walls (low_re) for laminar flow. low_re needs a first cell at y+ of about 1; none is for laminar CHT only.

patches.description: Actual wall patch names; empty uses native automatic wall selection.

reference_area.description: Reference area in m^2; positive for explicit mode, omitted/0 for auto_projected.

reference_area_mode.description: Explicit engineering reference area or a disclosed projected-area estimate.

reference_velocity.description: Reference speed in m/s; zero uses the freestream.

omega.description: Signed angular velocity in rad/s about axis (right-hand rule).

zone_id.description: Verified mesh cell zone ID. If cell_zone_name is supplied, the native mesh reader resolves its authoritative ID.

MeshUnitConversion.description: Interpret existing coordinate values for this run; never rewrite the source mesh.

NumericalControls.description: Explicit advanced numerical controls. Use get_solver_controls to find canonical names/types and get_tool_schema for the full schema. Unknown names are rejected.

characteristic_length_m.description: Hydraulic diameter in metres of the passage that carries the inlet flow, used for the Reynolds number that chooses laminar or turbulent flow when turbulence_model is auto. With a volumetric inlet the flow is taken through a circle of this diameter.

contact_resistances.description: Thermal contact resistance on named solid-solid interfaces; overrides the global cht_solid_contact_resistance on those interfaces.

expansion_coefficient_per_k.description: Fluid volumetric thermal expansion coefficient in 1/K for buoyancy. Default 1/T_ref for gases; required for liquids (water is about 2.1e-4).

gravity_m_s2.description: Gravity vector in m/s^2 in mesh coordinates, e.g. [0, 0, -9.81]; turns on buoyancy (Boussinesq) in every fluid zone. Omit for no buoyancy.

natural_convection_cycles.description: Buoyant flow/thermal re-solve cycles sharing max_iterations; default 3 when gravity is set.

convergence_criteria.description: How to judge this run converged when it finishes; omit for the standard test (every residual at or below 1e-3, none rising).

gpu_count.description: GPUs for the solve (default 1). CHT and Krylov runs use one.

idempotency_key.description: Use a fresh unique key for each new job, even with identical inputs or a matching finished job. Reuse it unchanged only to retry or resume that same intended job, an uncertain submission included.

notify_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL sent a signed notification when the job finishes, so you need not poll.
